suites.title: Initial policy, independence, and routing pilot
suites.purpose: Reproduce the first blinded comparison with one live policy case, one offline adversarial fixture, and one routing case.
suites.source_access: Live web for the policy case; fixture candidate sources only for mirrored evidence; no research tools for routing.

suites.title: Market, medical, academic, and technical pilot
suites.purpose: Repeat the second blinded comparison across four research categories and underspecified prompts.
suites.source_access: Live web with primary and official sources preferred.

suites.title: Non-trigger routing smoke suite
suites.purpose: Verify that quick facts, rewriting, and deterministic arithmetic do not start a deep-research workflow.
suites.source_access: No external sources or research tools.

suites.title: Offline copied-evidence regression
suites.purpose: Repeat the mirrored-evidence trap without live-web variability.
suites.source_access: Only candidate sources in evals/fixtures/mirrored-evidence/sources; evaluator ground truth is excluded.

suites.title: Offline evidence and output-structure regressions
suites.purpose: Repeat independence, current-release status, and duplicate-table traps without live-web variability.
suites.source_access: Only each case's declared fixture candidate sources; evaluator ground truth is excluded.

suites.title: High-discrimination offline evidence regressions
suites.purpose: Test independence, status, output structure, denominator normalization, negative-evidence limits, and date-sensitive definitions without live-web variability.
suites.source_access: Only each case's declared fixture candidate sources; evaluator ground truth is excluded.

suites.title: Region, transfer, and conditional parallelism
suites.purpose: Evaluate the portable depth protocols added in v2.7 without assuming vendor-specific orchestration.
suites.source_access: Live web with target-context primary sources; parallel workers only when the recorded runtime declaration and actual session provide them.
